$comment: NON-BREAKING new-tool payload for the Dasha Compute MCP catalog. Implements the V6 coverage gap top candidate from docs/MCP-TOOL-NAMING-AUDIT.md (PR #228), ranked #1 in docs/MCP-SERVER-INSTRUCTIONS.md (PR #230): a read-only, unauthenticated pricing tool, additive to the existing five tools (no renames, no behavior change to the live inventory). Worker lane: append tool to the tools[] array in mcp.json served at https://www.getdasha.com/compute/mcp.json; wire it to the pricing endpoint; bump the card version per the Server Card hygiene rules (PR #220).

completion_tokens.description: Expected completion tokens per job. Only completion tokens are billed ($0.01 per 1k); input tokens are collected so per-model cards can price them later.

input_tokens.description: Prompt tokens per job. Not billed under the standing rate card; collected so per-model cards can price input tokens later.

job_count.description: Number of jobs to cost. Defaults to 1.

model.description: Model id the workload would run on (e.g. qwen3-8b, gemma3-12b, gpt-oss-20b, qwen3-30b-a3b, gemma3-27b, gpt-oss-120b). Optional; omit for the rate card alone.

estimate.description: Workload estimate. Present whenever any input parameter is supplied.

assumptions.description: Which inputs were supplied vs defaulted.

breakdown_per_job_usd.description: Per-job cost: the $0.05 job fee plus the completion-token fee.

total_usd.description: job_count x per-job total, rounded to cents.

rate_card.description: The standing Dasha Compute rate card. Always present; this is the answer when no input parameters are supplied.

rate_card.free_tier: A free tier covers low-volume use (see the guest key flow via the guest key minting tool).

source: docs/MCP-TOOL-NAMING-AUDIT.md (PR #228) V6; ranked top V6 candidate in docs/MCP-SERVER-INSTRUCTIONS.md (PR #230). See docs/MCP-DASHA-PRICING-TOOL-PROPOSAL.md.

tool.description: Quote inference cost on the Dasha Compute Mac network before routing LLM jobs. Read-only: returns the standing rate card ($0.05 per job + $0.01 per 1k completion tokens; input tokens are not billed) and, when given a model, token counts, and a job count, breaks down the estimated cost per job and in total. Use with the Dasha models list to pick among qwen3-8b, gemma3-12b, gpt-oss-20b, qwen3-30b-a3b, gemma3-27b, gpt-oss-120b, then estimate before calling chat completions. It estimates — it never bills and never charges your key.
tool.name: dasha_pricing
tool.title: Dasha pricing quote
